releases.summary: プラグイン/Mod API、Managed Agents、権限・サンドボックス、セッション、VS Code、Claude Tagなどを更新。

sections.title: 新機能
items: 追加: `serverToolUses` to the result of a mod's `turn.step` hook: the tool calls the API ran itself (the advisor), each with its id, name, input, start and end
追加: `agentId` to the `tool.check` event of plugin hooks, so a hook can tell a subagent's permission check from the main session's
追加: `ceiling` to the question and verdict a mod's `tool.check` hook reads, naming the approval an organization requires for a tool
追加: `ThemeKey` and `Color` types to the plugin hooks typings, so an editor lists the theme colors a mod's drawing can name
追加: to `claude plugin validate`: each hook a mod registers at a gating site is listed with whether it has a `.catch` (`gatingHooks` under `--json`)
追加: a Deny button to the Claude apps gateway's sign-in approval page: it ends the pending sign-in, so the waiting terminal stops within seconds
追加: `claude attach <name>` and `claude logs <name>`: part of a session name works in place of the id
追加: `/claude-api managed-agents-onboard <url>` to set up the Managed Agents pattern a page describes as `ant apply` files
追加: `/claude-api managed-agents-onboard <quickstart-name>` to build a Console quickstart template, such as `deep-researcher`, with the `ant` CLI
追加: a warning when a managed settings file is a link to a file outside the managed settings folder
追加: a /status and doctor warning when managed settings ignore user-configured sandbox allowRead paths or allowed domains
追加: [VS Code] 作業中にメッセージを送ると、スクリーンリーダーへ「Message queued.」を通知。
追加: [VS Code] Manage pluginsダイアログから、プラグインマーケットプレイスのインストール／更新コマンドを確認・実行する機能。
追加: [Claude Tag] Slackで `!fast` を付けてClaudeにメンションすると高速モードへ切替（必要ならOpusへ移行）。`!fast off` で戻せ、返信中に fast 状態を表示。
追加: [Claude Tag] access bundle内のカスタム接続に任意のPath prefixes欄を追加し、許可ルールをホスト全体ではなく指定パスだけに適用可能に。

sections.title: 変更
items: 改善: MCP startup behind a network proxy: a server the proxy blocks (HTTP 403) is no longer retried three times
改善: permission prompts from background agents to show the Ctrl+X Ctrl+K shortcut that stops all background agents
改善: the built-in `plugin-authoring` skill: Claude now gives the one command another person runs to install a mod you made, and writes it in a README's install section
改善: the reply to `/plugin` in the desktop app's Code tab: it now says where to install and manage plugins there
改善: the Bash changed-files view: when a chained command includes git merge, pull or checkout, it lists the files without full diffs
改善: the Claude apps gateway's log when an upstream's cloud credentials or connection fail: the warning now ends with the underlying cause
改善: the error shown when a cloud session is started without a claude.ai sign-in: it now names `claude auth login` and /login and no longer blames API-key authentication
改善: the Read tool's message for binary files: it now points Claude to a skill or a shell command that can read the format
改善: the error shown when a git config file stops the `/ultrareview` upload: it is about half as long and says what kind of file is the problem
改善: the errors shown when the `/ultrareview` upload refuses a checkout: each known cause now has its own message, with a way to fix it
改善: the Claude apps gateway to log a warning during the last 30 days before the certificate it presents to the identity provider expires
改善: Claude in Chrome: a `browser_batch` call now gets 90 seconds, up from 60, before it is reported as timed out
改善: the Claude apps gateway's browser sign-in pages: brand fonts, centered layout, and dark mode
改善: responsiveness while resuming large sessions: timers, input and rendering keep running while the transcript loads
改善: the / and @ suggestion lists: the selected row now starts with a ❯ pointer, so you can see it without color
変更: `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` to also skip the startup connection warm-up
変更: Claude in Chrome so that a project's settings files can no longer turn it on; use `--chrome`, `/chrome` or your user settings
変更: the Bash tool to ask for permission before running `pyright`, which is no longer treated as a read-only command
変更: what a mod's `$.process.spawn` rejects with when another mod denies it after the child ran: it now says the call ran and a plugin withheld its result
変更: the background daemon's log to write a multi-line message as one JSON-quoted line
変更: skills and custom commands to refuse a `!` shell command that contains raw control characters other than tab and newline, with a message that shows where they are
変更: `/artifacts`: opening an artifact in your browser now closes the list
変更: Bash permission checks so that more forms of the `ps` command ask for approval instead of running without asking
変更: plugin hooks so long text is clipped and logged instead of being refused or dropped silently
変更: background sessions whose scheduled task is gone: they now move to Completed about 20 seconds later and can be updated or shut down when idle
変更: the "Press ← again" confirm on a just-cleared prompt: a second ← no longer has to wait a second before it switches, and holding ← down now switches too
変更: the errors shown when the `/ultrareview` upload fails at a git step: they name the step and what to try, and no longer repeat git's own error text
変更: `/code-review` at medium effort to also report cleanup and CLAUDE.md conventions findings on models without tuned review settings, including Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5
変更: an in-process teammate's `agent_id` in Agent results to its agent ID (its `name@team` address stays in `teammate_id`); TeammateIdle hooks no longer fire from its subagents or forks
変更: background sessions waiting on a scheduled wakeup (`/loop`): they are now left running through updates and low memory, where being restarted or shut down could silently lose the wakeup
変更: `/model`, `/effort` and `/rename` sent from `claude agents` to a busy background session to apply right away, without a confirmation, instead of when the turn ends
変更: the Claude apps gateway's minimum supported PostgreSQL version from 14 to 11
変更: the interactive session's WebSearch budget to refill over time (100 calls/hour; `CLAUDE_CODE_WEB_SEARCH_REFILLS_PER_HOUR` sets the rate, 0 turns it off) instead of ending after 200 calls
変更: `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ATTACHMENTS` so a repository's `.claude/settings.json` or `.claude/settings.local.json` can no longer set it; shell, user and managed settings still can
変更: `claude plugin update` on a plugin loaded from a directory to print just its reason, without the "Failed to update plugin" prefix, as for built-in plugins
変更: the built-in `gh api` in cloud sessions: a host other than github.com set in `GH_HOST` or `GH_REPO` is now refused (use `--hostname` or a full URL), and stderr notes requests to other hosts
変更: the `claude-api` skill's Managed Agents examples to turn off the web tools unless the agent needs them and to use the `auto` permission policy
変更: [Self-hosted runners] `claude --environment <id>` が現行Sessions API経由でセッションを作成し、表示・JSONのセッションIDは `session_…` 形式を維持。
改善: [VS Code] Continue After Reloadで、拡張機能の再起動後に再表示されたタブも中断されたステップを完了できるように。
改善: [VS Code] メッセージ内のファイルピルにホバーするとプロジェクト起点のパスを表示し、同名ファイルを識別可能に。
変更: [VS Code] メッセージ時刻をデフォルト表示に変更（Claude Code設定で非表示に可能）。
改善: [Claude Tag] 自分のClaudeプランが使用量上限に達した際のDM通知を数秒以内に表示し、リセット時刻も案内。
改善: [Claude Tag] 旧Claude in Slackアプリがセッションを開始できない場合、失敗内容と担当者を表示（詳細はスレッドごとに一度だけ）。
変更: [Claude Tag] チャンネル指示の上限をバイト数ではなく8,192文字へ変更し、非英語でも同じ容量を確保。保存画面に文字数も表示。

sections.title: 修正
items: 修正: requests failing behind proxies and gateways that reject one of Claude Code's beta headers with a status other than 400, or together with a second beta
修正: long sessions with hundreds of images getting stuck on "Request rejected as unprocessable by the model" errors
修正: a turn ending at once when the API's output content filter stopped a reply while Claude was still thinking; the request is now retried once before the error is shown
修正: resumed subagents and teammates losing their earlier thinking and prompt cache after receiving a message mid-run
修正: WebFetch silently dropping page text past 100,000 characters; it now says how much was unread and takes an `offset` to read on
修正: a crash ("Maximum call stack size exceeded") when a response nested lists or quotes thousands of levels deep
修正: `/rewind` not listing a prompt sent while Claude was still working
修正: scheduled tasks (`/loop` with an interval, reminders) silently not coming back on resume once the conversation was compacted; covers compactions made from this version on
修正: scheduled tasks set in the foreground never firing after a ← or `/background` hand-off, and recurring ones firing an extra run on every resume, respawn or fork
修正: headless `--json-schema` runs exiting non-zero with `is_error: true` on a `success` result when the connection dropped after the structured output was already delivered
修正: plan mode letting the auto mode classifier approve non-read-only connector tools that carry a server-pushed ask policy
修正: a project `CLAUDE.md`, rule or `AGENTS.md` symlinked outside the working directories loading under `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` or a `Read` deny rule
修正: URL allow and deny patterns with a wildcard inside an `xn--` host label matching differently from one process to the next
修正: an MCP server provided by your organization being relisted as your own after signing in or reconnecting, including from a late result in headless and SDK sessions
修正: `/ultrareview` dropping uncommitted changes without a warning on Windows when `git stash create` failed, and refusing them after a `git add -N` file was deleted or moved
修正: the `plansDirectory` setting's project-root check for paths that contain a backslash on macOS and Linux
修正: replies in very long Remote Control and cloud sessions that could appear a block at a time instead of streaming in
修正: the background daemon's log passing terminal control characters to the screen under `claude daemon run` and `claude daemon logs`; they now show as `\uXXXX` escapes
修正: a plugin hook with a `.catch` being unloaded, and its `.catch` skipped, when the hook kept the hooks worker busy on a prompt or tool call
修正: a mod's `turn.step` result listing a tool call that a mid-response model fallback had discarded
修正: a Cowork cloud session's reply sometimes never finishing when its container restarted just after Claude sent a message or a file
修正: `claude plugin validate` and plugin loading refusing a hooks module that destructures an option named like one of its top-level functions
修正: `/ultrareview` failing to upload uncommitted changes when `core.safecrlf=true` is set in git's configuration
修正: the effort level changing when a flagged message is retried on a fallback model that has a different level saved in settings
修正: Claude Code hanging until killed when a `/permissions` tab was clicked while searching in fullscreen mode
修正: conversation compaction sometimes failing with a "null is not an object" error
修正: plugin hooks reading an empty `answer` on `turn.complete` for a subagent that hands its report back in auto mode
修正: a mod being unloaded without a message when a refresh followed its failed reload; its failure line now says the version loaded before is unloaded
修正: a mod's `prompt.submit` hook that drops a prompt after calling `next(e)` being ignored silently: the hook is now reported as failed, by name
修正: a mod's pane or band being redrawn without end when it followed its end over a tree that changed height at every drawing
修正: an image read on macOS and Windows being able to return a file outside what was approved, through a link swapped in mid-read
修正: a case where a user-installed mod could get an organization's plugin unloaded; the mod is now the one unloaded
修正: `disableClaudeAiConnectors` and `allowedMcpServers` URL rules not being applied to some MCP entries declared in `.mcp.json`, plugins or agents
修正: a mod's inline pane being redrawn without end when its tree changed height at every drawing
修正: an `@`-mention under the read block or `--restricted` being able to read a file outside the working directories through a link changed mid-read
修正: Esc in the agents view confirming "Press enter again to restart this session — it isn't responding"; Esc now just reopens the session
修正: agent view losing a background session's `/loop` run count, countdown and live status line after the session enters a worktree that it creates
修正: `claude agents` sessions in manual permission mode asking for approval to read an image pasted into a reply or a new agent's prompt
修正: a deny or ask rule missing a command or path whose name came from a variable set as a prefix on `declare`, `typeset`, `export` or `readonly`
修正: Read deny rules not applying to image paths pasted or dragged into the prompt, or to file names listed for an @-mentioned folder
修正: a case where a user-installed mod could make an organization's guard skip its check; such a mod is now unloaded
修正: plugin hooks stalling each redraw when a mod draws a long multi-line text holding non-Latin characters
修正: repeated Ctrl+X in the agents view deleting the whole next section after the bottom session of a section was deleted
修正: You should know writing its notes in English regardless of the `language` setting
修正: a freeze after sending some very long messages
修正: a slowdown when expanding the transcript (ctrl+o) or resizing over large tool output that contains non-ASCII characters such as arrows, dashes or box-drawing
修正: `claude respawn` re-sending an earlier message to a backgrounded session that has no saved transcript instead of starting it with an empty conversation
修正: Esc after an `n:` or Ctrl+F search in the agents view moving focus to a section header, where Ctrl+X twice would delete every session in the section
修正: `claude agents` saving a slash command it could not deliver to a stopped session and then running it by itself the next time that session restarted
修正: `/ultrareview` uploading uncommitted changes unfiltered for files under a git filter driver named `unset` or `unspecified`; the upload now stops and asks you to rename the driver
修正: auto mode denials suggesting a permission rule that would skip the classifier for a whole tool or that Claude Code would ignore
修正: `claude --teleport` and `/teleport` deleting the files in a folder that had replaced a tracked file of the same name when you chose to stash: the stash is now refused, and says why
修正: Esc confirming agent view's "Press enter again to restart this session fresh" prompt
修正: agent view's `/loop` run count freezing and its countdown disappearing after `/clear`; the count now restarts with the new conversation
修正: `--channels` permission relay: a reply ID that repeats within a session is now ignored instead of approving a different prompt
修正: `/chrome` "Reconnect extension" not restoring browser tools after a failed Chrome connection, and added an explanation when it can't (anthropics/claude-code#98135)
修正: mods staying off for people who reach Claude through a gateway (`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` with `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`) and have no Anthropic account
修正: replies sent from `claude agents` just after a background session crashed being refused after 2 seconds: they are now retried for up to 12 seconds while the session restarts
修正: slash commands and answers to a multiple-choice question that `claude agents` could not deliver to a running session being saved and sent by themselves the next time it was restarted
修正: sandboxed commands that pipe a heredoc into another command (`cat <<EOF | python3`) asking for approval on every run
修正: `claude agents` failing with "Couldn't restart the background service" and background sessions stopping after a Homebrew upgrade (takes effect from the upgrade after this one)
修正: agent view's "restart this session fresh" re-sending an earlier message from the session instead of starting with an empty conversation
修正: Bash permission checks auto-approving some read-only commands (such as `rg` or `git grep`) whose arguments the shell would still expand as wildcards; these now prompt for approval
修正: `claude plugin test` refusing to run after an upgrade because of an out-of-date saved setting
修正: Bash permission checks auto-approving certain commands whose variable names zsh reads differently from bash; these now prompt for approval
修正: a short form of a `git clone` option keeping the sandbox exemption from a git pattern such as `git *` in `sandbox.excludedCommands`; it is now treated like the long form
修正: the first feature-flag request of a session ignoring a proxy or API endpoint set in a project's settings
修正: `/ultrareview` of a local branch silently leaving uncommitted work out of the upload in a repository that keeps its branches outside `.git` (git 2.54+); it now refuses with an explanation
修正: cloud sessions staying asleep after a container restart lost a pending `/loop` wakeup or scheduled task; Claude is now told and can schedule it again
修正: the Claude apps gateway's retention sweep deleting a returning developer's identity row refreshed at the same moment, on PostgreSQL versions without the November 2025 fixes
修正: sandboxed Monitor tool commands skipping the permission prompt under sandbox auto-allow; they now follow your permission rules
修正: the Claude apps gateway failing to start when the certificate it presents to the identity provider has an empty subject
修正: the Claude apps gateway exiting with a bare "Invalid URL" when `store.postgres_url` can't be parsed; the error now names the setting and says what the URL may hold
修正: background agents failing with "Agent stalled" and Workflow tool subagents restarting from their prompt when a Mac woke from sleep
修正: slow or failed startup since 2.1.285 under SDK hosts such as the VS Code extension when managed settings deny reads of many paths on a slow filesystem (notably Windows drives under WSL)
修正: a response interrupted by computer sleep being treated as a stalled stream on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and custom gateways
修正: a freeze before the first request and in the `/sandbox` Config tab on Linux and WSL when a sandbox read rule such as `~/**/.env` covers a large folder
修正: skills not being found when asked for by the name in SKILL.md when their folder has a different name (for example a non-English name): the skill listing now shows both names
修正: a plan written in plan mode being lost when a cloud session's container restarted before the plan was presented
修正: the Bash tool occasionally losing shell aliases, functions and plugin PATH entries for a whole session when its first command ran seconds after startup on a new config directory
修正: unbounded memory use when an HTTP MCP server sends a very large response
修正: artifact operations failing in a Claude Code run started from inside a cloud session (for example `claude -p` run from the Bash tool)
修正: files sent from remote sessions sometimes being refused as "not the one approved" when four or more were sent at once
修正: plan mode not being restored when resuming a session with `--continue` or `--resume <session-id>` in the terminal
修正: a marketplace named after another GitHub marketplace's download folder stopping that marketplace from downloading
修正: automatic compaction giving up with "Prompt is too long" when a Mac went to sleep while it was running
修正: the rewind menu (Esc Esc / `/rewind`) freezing for hundreds of milliseconds per keypress when the conversation contains a very large pasted stack trace or source file
修正: a subdirectory's AGENTS.md not being attached when a file under it is @-mentioned
修正: self-hosted runner sessions resumed after a stopped runner failing with "missing but already registered worktree" when the sessions folder is a relative symlink
修正: a freeze when the secret scan or a permission prompt met long token-like text
修正: Bash permission checks not applying Read deny rules or the outside-directory read block to a wildcard in some option values of read-only commands
修正: `CLAUDE_CODE_USER_DIALOG_TIMEOUT_MS=5m` being read as 5 ms and cancelling remote dialogs at once; values with a unit suffix now fall back to `dialogExpiry`
修正: a stall when an MCP server's tool listing contains very long runs of combining characters
修正: two pastes that overlap in one prompt being sent to the model partly as typed text instead of as one pasted block
修正: Claude in Chrome's browser picker showing a message meant for Claude when the chosen browser is no longer connected, and the VS Code dialog's list going stale after a switch
修正: background subagents losing write and Bash access in their worktree after the main session enters or exits a different worktree

修正: background commands, the agents view and daemon workers sending telemetry and a feature-flag request to Anthropic behind a Claude apps gateway when no managed settings on the machine force gateway login
修正: `--restricted` (and `CLAUDE_CODE_RESTRICTED=1`) sessions opening the cross-session messaging socket
修正: sessions moved to the background while idle reopening as "no saved transcript" after a restart or idle cleanup; they now resume their conversation
修正: background workers honoring `--allow-dangerously-skip-permissions` on respawn without the bypass-permissions disclaimer having been accepted
修正: Claude replying in an endless loop when a plugin's async Stop hook passes an unquoted script path under a folder with a space, such as Application Support
修正: a freeze of several seconds when secret masking met very long unbroken text
修正: some permission rules and safety checks not being applied to a tool call after a PreToolUse hook rewrote its input
修正: first launch asking to pick a login method again after `claude auth login` or with a credentials file already in the config directory
修正: file names containing line breaks being displayed incorrectly in file tool errors and permission prompts
修正: a large paste expanded in place being sent to the model as typed text after the next keystroke when it held accents stored as separate characters, as macOS file names do
修正: macOS `/login` reporting success when the keychain refused the new login and kept an old one it could not remove
修正: SDK hosts using `--include-partial-messages` seeing a reply stay open after the turn ended when its stream was cut, interrupted or fell back to non-streaming
修正: sandboxed Bash commands on Linux running `ConfigChange` hooks and reloading settings mid-command when `.claude/settings.json` or `.claude/settings.local.json` does not exist
修正: errors reading "Premature close" instead of naming the missing program when a tool Claude Code runs, such as git or gh, is not installed (macOS, Linux)
修正: `/loop` and other recurring session-only scheduled tasks running an extra time after a sandboxed Bash command on Linux or after `.claude/scheduled_tasks.json` was deleted
修正: edits to the file a symlinked settings file points at running without the settings-file permission question
修正: [Self-hosted runner] 細工された非常に長いセッションエラー出力行で、ランナーが数秒間フリーズする問題。
修正: Windowsで、CRLF改行のファイルに保存されたskills／commands内の複数行 `!` シェルブロックが失敗する問題。
修正: [VS Code] 未入力の空チャットを開くと、保存済み会話に切り替えた後もバックグラウンドのClaudeプロセスが残る問題。
修正: [VS Code] 保存時にClaude Codeが予期せず停止すると、設定ダイアログがタイムアウトと誤表示する問題。
修正: [VS Code] 未コミット変更を確認できない場合にもブランチ切替ダイアログが切替を提案する問題。
修正: [VS Code] 開いているダイアログの背後に届いた権限プロンプトがキーボードフォーカスを奪い、ダイアログでのキー入力が回答になる問題。
修正: [VS Code] Claude Codeの実行ファイルを見つけられない／起動できないとき、サインインと新規セッションで原因が明確に示されない問題。
修正: [VS Code] エージェントマップがネストしたサブエージェントを「Tool calls (0)」と表示し、その配下で開始したエージェントをメインエージェント下に配置する問題。
修正: [Cloud sessions] 環境変数でprompt suggestionsを無効にしても新規クラウドセッションに反映されない問題。
修正: [Cloud sessions] Claudeの返信完了後も作業インジケーターが数秒回り続ける問題。
修正: [Cloud sessions] 一度も実行していないroutineのページでRun nowを押してもHistoryが「No runs yet」のままになる問題。
修正: [Cloud sessions] アーカイブ解除したクラウドセッションが次のメッセージまで作業中に見える問題。
修正: [Remote Control] 起動直後のコンピューターが新規セッションのRemote Controlメニューに表示されるまで最大1分かかる問題。
修正: [Claude Tag] Claude Tag Admin権限のメンバーがActivityのMemoryタブで「Couldn't load memory files」となり、ワークスペース／チャンネルメモリを読めない問題。
修正: [Claude Tag] Slack設定カードでゲストがConfirmすると全員のボタンが消える問題。拒否はゲストだけに表示され、メンバーは確認・取消を続行可能に。
修正: [Claude Tag] Slackチャンネルのscheduled routinesがチャンネル既定とは別のモデルで動く問題。新規セッションを始める各実行で現行の既定モデルを使用。
修正: [Claude Tag] チャンネル名ルールで紐付いたaccess bundle内のGitHubリポジトリが、対象チャンネルで拒否される問題。追加・一覧・cloneを可能に。
修正: [Code Review] ブロッキングのレビューコメントが重大度と矛盾する「nit」ラベルで開かれることがある問題。
修正: [Code Review] Code Reviewを無効にした組織のforkおよびManual-mode PRで「@claude review」とコメントする案内が投稿される問題。

exclusions: X MCPが利用不可のため、公式XおよびAnthropic engineer Xの投稿は未確認として除外。
対象期間外の公式ブログ・Anthropic記事・Claude Codeリリースは除外。Claude CodeはGitHub CLIで取得した公式メタデータと完全なrelease bodyを使用。
